subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu DM sessions rebuilt after gateway restart — duplicate keys + maintenance pruning

question: What durable Feishu DM identity and retention policy should OpenClaw use for multi-account direct messages, and how should existing malformed or unscoped session rows be repaired?
rationale: The fix crosses durable session-key identity, direct-DM retention behavior, and possible doctor migration; automation can identify the unsafe paths but cannot choose the compatibility and growth tradeoff safely.

options.title: Targeted Feishu DM Repair
options.body: Validate Feishu open_id/user_id inputs, add duplicate detection or doctor repair, and use TTL-aware direct-session preservation for active DMs without changing unrelated channels.

options.title: Account-Scoped DM Migration
options.body: Move multi-account Feishu DMs to account-scoped keys with an explicit doctor migration, accepting a controlled history split for existing per-channel keys.

options.title: Document Workaround Only
options.body: Keep per-account-channel-peer and maxEntries guidance as the supported workaround while leaving cleanup and malformed-key repair unresolved.

recommendation.title: Targeted Feishu DM Repair
recommendation.body: Validate Feishu open_id/user_id inputs, add duplicate detection or doctor repair, and use TTL-aware direct-session preservation for active DMs without changing unrelated channels.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent Feishu identity review signal and authored related Feishu DM work, while session-maintenance owners can review the retention mechanics.
